column4: cleat#1963/cleat#2078: races two real sessions on claim Step 4's own UPDATE text against a genuinely-held lock, SQL Server only -- this job sets CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres) but no CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the test skips here on every run. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestMSSQLClaimStep4RecheckPreventsDoubleClaim -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one.
